response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: A missing status means powerstatus IS NULL. NULLs form one group, and empty strings would count as their own separate status.

The average share across statuses is the unweighted mean of the per-status shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of status groups including the NULL group. It is not the share of telescopes overall.
Shares are fractions between 0 and 1, not percentages.
